item.description: Toronto has just added a unique hotel to its roster of short-term lodges: the Pod-Inn Hotel, designed specifically for solo travellers and students on a budget.But this is not your typical hotel experience. Each Pod-Inn Hotel room comes with a bed, a smart television, power outlets, and comfortable lighting — that's it.
